summary.text: A centaur who fled the wedding battle beside Pholus, Abas, and Asbolus when the fight turned to rout.

story.text: When the brawl at Peirithous' feast broke into open war, Ovid shows Pholus and Melaneus running for their lives with Abas the boar-hunter and Asbolus the augur — the centaur party scattering as brands and weapons flew through the hall.
